qaItems.question: What is this application?
qaItems.answer: This is a Q&A chatbot application built to provide quick answers to common questions. You can search, browse by category, or chat with the bot.

qaItems.question: How do I search for questions?
qaItems.answer: Use the search box at the top to find questions by keyword. Results update in real-time as you type.

qaItems.question: Is my data private?
qaItems.answer: Yes, this application runs locally in your browser. No data is sent to external servers.

qaItems.question: What browsers are supported?
qaItems.answer: This app works on all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.

qaItems.question: Can I add more questions?
qaItems.answer: Yes! Edit the qa-data.json file to add new questions and answers. The app will load them automatically.

qaItems.question: How do I get started?
qaItems.answer: Browse questions by category, use search, or start typing in the chat interface to ask questions.
